symptom: Friend requests not sent / nothing happens for other person
action: A sends friend request to B; check request row and notification creation in Supabase
evidence: follow_requests insert: OK, but notifications insert FAILED with error: "null value in column "id" of relation "notifications" violates not-null constraint" (1446ms). Recipient receives no database notification or live badge.
cause: notifications table in Supabase has a NOT NULL constraint on "id" with no default UUID generator, and notifications are only saved to localStorage on sender's device.

symptom: When request is sent, other student cannot accept it
action: B accepts request; verify single-step atomic transaction and live friends list update
evidence: friendships table does not exist (PGRST205); accept_friend_request RPC does not exist (PGRST202). Acceptance is executed via client-side DataStore.acceptFollowRequest and partial /api/sync POST.
cause: No atomic database function (RPC) for accepting requests. State is split across client localStorage, /api/sync memory, and non-atomic follows table updates.

symptom: Friend request edge cases (self-request, decline, cancel, blocked, deactivated)
action: Probe database constraints and edge-case validation for self-request and blocked users
evidence: Database allowed inserting a self-request (requester=target="test_self_probe"). No check constraint (requester <> target) on follow_requests table. No rate-limiting or mutual auto-accept trigger.
cause: Missing database check constraint (requester <> target) and lack of RPC enforcing business logic for blocked, pending-approval, or duplicate requests.

symptom: Requests on unapproved or special-case account shapes
action: Send request to pending-approval / unverified student account
evidence: follow_requests table accepts requests to unapproved student account (test_pending_dummy) without verifying is_approved status.
cause: Database has no foreign key check or trigger ensuring requester and target are approved active students.

symptom: People who are requested (request pending) cannot send messages
action: Inspect chat send permissions and inbox tier for pending requests
evidence: When user A requests user B, A is not yet followed by B. In DataStore.canChatAndShare, messages are classified as REQUESTS tier, but UI composer requires target to be an accepted follow before direct chat bubble is opened seamlessly.
cause: Chat inbox tier routing classifies non-mutual follows as REQUESTS, but chats/page.tsx lacks clear next-step CTA for pending friend requests.

symptom: Unfriend: both lists update, friendship row removed for both
action: Check unfriend logic across client and database
evidence: DataStore.toggleFollow only deletes the single direction (follower=cur, following=target). The reverse follow remains intact unless target also unfollows. No atomic unfriend RPC exists.
cause: Asymmetric follow model used instead of atomic bidirectional friendship removal.

symptom: Friend request rate-limiting and abuse prevention
action: Check request limits per minute and per day
evidence: Zero rate limits in follow_requests table, /api/sync, or client DataStore. A client can loop-send unlimited friend requests without rejection or throttle message.
cause: No rate limiter or daily limit counter enforced in database or API.

symptom: Groups are not being created / create-group glitches
action: Verify group creation across database and client
evidence: group_members table does not exist in Supabase (PGRST205: Could not find the table 'public.group_members' in the schema cache). DataStore.createGroup saves group to localStorage and only sends to /api/sync, which does not persist to Supabase groups. Groups are invisible to other devices.
cause: Supabase database lacks group_members and group_invitations tables, and /api/sync never writes groups to Supabase.

symptom: Create-group edge cases: solo creator group disallowed, screen glitches
action: Verify UI modal validation and edge case handling in groups/page.tsx
evidence: groups/page.tsx enforces "disabled={selectedGroupMembers.length === 0}" and alerts "Please select at least one student to invite". A student cannot create a personal group. No image upload button for group avatar.
cause: Hardcoded UI restriction requiring at least 1 invitee, and absence of Cloudflare group icon upload.

action: Check /api/chats sender authorization for group conversation IDs
evidence: In src/app/api/chats/route.ts POST, sender check "conversationId.includes('__')" only executes for direct 1-to-1 chats. For group chats (conv-group-*), any user can POST messages to any group conversation ID without membership verification.
cause: api/chats/route.ts does not verify sender membership for group conversation IDs.

symptom: Add person into a group afterwards / admin adds friend D
action: Verify member addition to existing groups
evidence: Because groups and memberships are not stored in Supabase, newly accepted friends cannot be added from another device. DataStore.addMemberToGroup only updates local storage.
cause: No persistent database table or RPC to add members to groups.

action: Check group_invitations storage and live delivery
evidence: group_invitations table does not exist (PGRST205). Invitations live in memory in serverStore and local storage; other devices do not receive invitations.

symptom: Group management: leave, remove member, change admin
action: Inspect group management methods in DataStore and API
evidence: No functions or UI exist for a member to leave a group, for an admin to remove a member, or to reassign admin role when the last admin departs.
cause: Group management features are incomplete and lack database backing.

symptom: Existing groups persistence and reload across devices
action: Query Supabase groups table for real student groups
evidence: Supabase groups table contains 1 rows (only the probe test group). Real student groups were never persisted to Supabase and disappear on browser cache clear or device change.
cause: Groups were stored exclusively in client localStorage and ephemeral serverStore.

symptom: RLS policies on friends, groups, group_members, notifications
action: Audit live database policies and missing tables
evidence: RLS on groups has no DELETE policy; group_members and friendships tables do not exist; notifications table rejects inserts without an explicit id.
cause: Incomplete database schema and missing RLS policies.

symptom: Privacy: non-participant cannot read/post to groups or requests of others
action: Verify API route gating against non-members
evidence: POST /api/chats does not check group membership for group chats. Any student who knows or guesses a group conversation ID can post into it.
cause: Missing group membership authorization check in /api/chats.

symptom: Realtime updates for friend requests and group invitations
action: Check Supabase Realtime publication for friend requests and groups
evidence: No Supabase Realtime channel subscriptions active for follow_requests, groups, or group invitations. Incoming requests only appear upon page reload or manual sync.
cause: Absence of Realtime listeners for friendship and group events.

symptom: Create-group screen glitches and mobile viewport issues
action: Inspect create-group modal rendering and state handling
evidence: Create group modal re-renders liveFollowing on every tick interval; submit button lacks loading indicator; modal does not account for soft keyboard on mobile viewport causing layout jumps.
cause: Unmemoized tick dependency and missing mobile keyboard handling.

symptom: Current resource limits check vs free-tier quotas
action: Evaluate current usage: DB rows, storage, API requests
evidence: Supabase DB: 12 profiles, 319 messages, 1 groups (<1% of 500MB limit). Well within all free-tier quotas.
